data.one_liner: Widget for custom PIN entry screens with optional fingerprint and custom keyboard
data.what_it_does: Provides a PIN authentication screen and a customizable numeric keyboard. It supports callbacks for input changes, special keys, and fingerprint authentication.
use_when: Implementing a PIN-based login or verification screen
Adding a custom numeric keypad to an existing form
Integrating fingerprint authentication for PIN entry
avoid_when: Building a full authentication system that requires backend verification
Needing advanced form validation beyond PIN input
strengths: Easy to integrate with minimal code
weaknesses: No built-in backend or state management integration
No support for complex form validation
data.minimal_example:
```dart
import 'package:custom_pin_screen/custom_pin_screen.dart';

PinAuthentication(
  onChanged: (v) => print(v),
  onSpecialKeyTap: () {},
  specialKey: const SizedBox(),
  useFingerprint: true,
  onbuttonClick: () {},
  submitLabel: const Text('Submit'),
);
```
